main_issue: Whether and when Agent D can cook strong-smelling fish curry in the shared kitchen given smell impacts on A's calls, B's room and C's laundry

A-B.evidence: B (2) and A (3) both complain about the smell; A asked for no strong-smelling cooking and B backs this (10), though B later accepts a warning-based fix (19) while A still objects (27, 29).

A-C.evidence: C (5, 11) backs complaint about smell; C accepts Tue/Thu cooking (24, 26) while A says that still harms calls (27).

A-D.evidence: D initially refuses (6); proposes weekends (12) and A accepts (13); later D accepts Tue/Thu and questions A's timing (28), A still objects (29, 32), unresolved.

B-C.evidence: C: 'She's right' (11) supporting B; both say weekends fail (15, 16); B accepts a heads-up while C says warning doesn't help (24).

B-D.evidence: D refuses at first (6) but B proposes 'tell me before you start' (19), D agrees (20), B thanks (22).

C-D.evidence: C asks D to cook on non-laundry days (24); D: 'Okay. I can do that' (25); C: 'thanks' (26).
